description:
Add Room database persistence to the TaskTracker Android project. The project is already open in Android Studio and builds successfully, but has no database layer.

You need to:

1. Add the KSP Gradle plugin to the project-level build.gradle.kts:
   - Add: id("com.google.devtools.ksp") version "1.9.22-1.0.17" apply false

2. Add KSP plugin and Room dependencies to app/build.gradle.kts:
   - Apply plugin: id("com.google.devtools.ksp")
   - Add these dependencies (Room version 2.6.1):
     - implementation("androidx.room:room-runtime:2.6.1")
     - implementation("androidx.room:room-ktx:2.6.1")
     - ksp("androidx.room:room-compiler:2.6.1")

3. Create the Task entity at app/src/main/java/com/example/tasktracker/data/Task.kt:
   - Annotate with @Entity(tableName = "tasks")
   - Fields: 
     - id: Int (primary key, auto-generate)
     - title: String
     - description: String? (nullable)
     - isCompleted: Boolean (default false)
     - createdAt: Long

4. Create the TaskDao interface at app/src/main/java/com/example/tasktracker/data/TaskDao.kt:
   - Annotate with @Dao
   - Methods:
     - getAll(): returns List<Task>, Query: "SELECT * FROM tasks ORDER BY createdAt DESC"
     - getById(id: Int): returns Task?, Query: "SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id = :id"
     - insert(task: Task): @Insert
     - update(task: Task): @Update
     - delete(task: Task): @Delete
     - deleteAll(): Query: "DELETE FROM tasks"

5. Create the AppDatabase class at app/src/main/java/com/example/tasktracker/data/AppDatabase.kt:
   - Annotate with @Database(entities = [Task::class], version = 1)
   - Abstract class extending RoomDatabase
   - Abstract method: fun taskDao(): TaskDao

6. Ensure the project builds successfully (./gradlew assembleDebug should pass).

All new source files go under the package com.example.tasktracker.data.
